VALID_SIGNAL.label: Valid signal
VALID_SIGNAL.help: The alert was justified and the investigation was warranted. This is not confirmation of any disease or outbreak.

FALSE_ALERT.label: False alert
FALSE_ALERT.help: Investigation found no meaningful underlying pattern.

RESOLVED.label: Resolved
RESOLVED.help: The situation was addressed or explained and needs no further action.

relationshipMap.title: Evidence relationship map
relationshipMap.onlyOneSource: Only one source has usable data for this window, so no agreement/disagreement relationship can be established yet.
relationshipMap.descriptionPrefix: Each source below is compared against
relationshipMap.descriptionSuffix: , the source that most likely drove this alert — the one with the largest rise against its own baseline.
relationshipMap.disagreementWarning: Sources disagree — investigate why. This does not mean either source is wrong; it means the pattern needs a closer look before acting on it.
relationshipMap.footer: This map is decision support only. It never declares an outbreak, closes an alert, or changes the deterministic safety engine's verdict — the health officer decides what to investigate.

crossLevel.title: Cross-Level Intelligence
crossLevel.disclaimer: This comparison is performed on aggregated counts only. No patient record crosses from RuralCare into community analysis, so the linkage happens without centralising identifiable data.
